paper_title: Feedback Friction LLMs Struggle to Fully Incorporate External Feedback
caption: Accuracy of Llama4 Scout (top) and Llama4 Maverick (bottom) on 5-digit multiplication.
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the relationship between initial confidence and accuracy for three metrics—Final Accuracy (blue solid line with circular markers), Δ Accuracy (orange dashed line with diamond markers), and Initial Accuracy (green dotted line with square markers)—across a range of initial confidence values from 0.95 to 0.99. The x-axis, labeled "Initial Confidence," is scaled linearly with values increasing from left to right, and the y-axis, labeled "Accuracy," is also linear, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0. The blue "Final Acc" line starts at approximately 0.90 when initial confidence is 0.95, rises slightly to a peak of about 0.93 at an initial confidence of 0.98, and then decreases to roughly 0.89 at 0.99. The orange "Δ Acc" line begins at approximately 0.90, shows a slight dip to around 0.87 at an initial confidence of 0.96, then increases to about 0.91 at 0.98, before declining to approximately 0.76 at 0.99. The green "Initial Acc" line remains consistently low, starting near 0.00 at 0.95, rising slightly to about 0.01 at 0.96, then increasing to approximately 0.05 at 0.98, and finally reaching about 0.12 at 0.99. Error bars are visible on all data points, indicating variability in the measurements.
